ListContractsAsync(int, int, CancellationToken)

Lists Service Contracts (ListarContratos) so a contract can be resolved by the number the user knows (cNumCtr) — Omie offers no search by contract number. List once and index in memory: consulting contract by contract is what trips Omie's "Consumo redundante" gate.
